covers.title: Rapid quenching by ram-pressure stripping in a young cluster at $z = 1.7$

assertions.text: This manuscript is not under consideration at any other journal, and no part of it has been published elsewhere.
The authors declare no competing financial or non-financial interests.
The reduced spectra, member catalogue and velocity cube are deposited in the Example Science Archive under accession ESA-2026-0042.
All figure-generating scripts and the stripping model are in the project repository and will be released on publication.
Both authors have seen and approved this submission.

assertions.reason: This is an observational astronomy study; no human participants are involved.
This is an observational astronomy study; no animals are involved.

abbreviatedSummary: A galaxy caught mid-stripping in a z = 1.7 cluster loses its star-forming gas from the outside in, on a timescale short enough to explain the quenched population these clusters already contain.
